- Build a complete, playable 3D action-adventure story game with an open-world feel and AAA-quality presentation, making reasonable assumptions without clarification.

- Deliver a playable game now.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (maximum 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Created **EMBERFALL — The Last Light**, a browser-based Three.js adventure set on the Sundered Coast.

- Used procedural terrain, foliage, ruins, characters, enemies, lighting, and UI rather than external game assets.

## Objective
- Build and refine EMBERFALL into a playable 3D action-adventure game, improving visual realism and character animation while balancing tougher enemies and adding a jump mechanic.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Refine objects and graphics to be hyper realistic and make more animations for characters and make enemies high difficult to to balance out mechanics and ad a jump”.
- Keep the existing game playable and verify visual changes with a screenshot no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- The game is a browser-based Three.js adventure, EMBERFALL — The Last Light, using procedurally generated scenery and characters.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented and tested the core story, shard collection, beacon interaction, boss summon, and combat.
- Removed temporary `window.__emberfallDebug` and `window.__emberfallTeleport` helpers from `game.js`.
- `node --check game.js` passed; latest saved screenshot is `screenshots/emberfall.jpg` (1050×793).

### Active
- Implement the requested visual refinements, additional character animations, increased enemy difficulty with balanced mechanics, and jump.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add jump input, movement, landing, and mobile/UI control support; update control hints.
2. Improve procedural object/material detail and character animation using existing Three.js models.
3. Tune enemy difficulty and counterplay together, then verify progression and combat.
4. Run `node --check game.js`, test the game in-browser, and save/inspect a current JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Three.js scene, procedural assets, player movement/combat, enemies, and story logic.
- `index.html`: HUD, controls hints, mobile buttons, and screens.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive/mobile styling.
- `package.json`: Start script (`npm start`, port 3002).
- `screenshots/emberfall.jpg`: Latest saved visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing controls: WASD move, Shift sprint, Space dodge, click strike, E interact; mouse drag adjusts camera.
- Player and enemy characters are currently assembled from simple procedural meshes; movement has little animation.
- Enemy balancing and jump remain unimplemented.
